newsitem.title: USA: Old Kent trust issues $100 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Old Kent trust issues $100 mln in debt.

text.p: Old Kent Financial Corp said a Delaware business trust it controls, Old Kent Capital Trust I, has issued $100 million of Floating Rate Subordinated Capital Income Securities.

Old Kent said the securities, issued in a private placement on January 31, are structured to yield at 90 basis points over the 3 month LIBOR rate. They mature February 1, 2027, and are callable at par after 10 years or if certain events occur.

The bank holding company said the securities have not been registered under the Securities Act of 1933. They cannot be offered or sold in the United States without such a registration or an exemption from registration requirements.
